name: Onboarding: get new signups to their first result

steps.subject: Welcome, {{name|there}}
steps.text:
Hi {{name|there}},

Thanks for signing up. The fastest way to see value is to create your first project:
https://app.example.com/new

Reply to this email if you get stuck; a person reads it.

steps.subject: Did you get your first project going?
steps.text:
Hi {{name|there}},

Most people who stick around create a project in their first two days. If something got in the way, tell me what and I will help.

steps.subject: Three things teams do next
steps.text:
Hi {{name|there}},

1. Invite a teammate.
2. Connect your data.
3. Set up a weekly report.

https://app.example.com/next

steps.subject: Your trial: what you have used so far
steps.text:
Hi {{name|there}},

Your trial ends soon. Upgrading keeps your projects and history:
https://app.example.com/upgrade

steps.subject: We have not seen you in a while
steps.text:
Hi {{name|there}},

Something change? Reply with one line and I will read it.

Pick up where you left off: https://app.example.com

steps.subject: What we shipped since you left
steps.text:
Hi {{name|there}},

A short list of what is new: https://app.example.com/changelog
